Subject: [UAI] Computer Assisted Instruction and Computer Managed Instruction

I would appreciate learning of any applications of Bayesian methods, 
in  particular Bayesian networks, to computer assisted instruction 
and computer managed instruction. By computer managed instruction I 
mean custimizing instruction according to an individual's needs.
Thanks,
Rich

Richard E. Neapolitan
Professor and Chair of Computer Science
Northeastern Illinois University
5500 N. St. Louis
Chicago, Illinois 60625
